notes: Round 9 (scratch_r2, 1.32M decisions): the hunt begins from nothing. Speed 0.25 to 0.80 of a walk speed, Attack mode 24% to 37%, wounds dealt 0.57 to 1.18 healths a summary, a kill in one summary of thirteen; the chase pays 0.0008 to 0.003 a decision. They still starve (98%, after 240 s) next to carcasses: six deer starve per summary and the wolves walk to them (scent 0.0035) but Feed mode went down (18% to 14%) and they feed 0.09% of the time. Halving gnaw in round 9 took away the step between reaching a carcass and eating it. Round 10: gnaw pays three times more but by how far the muzzle is brought down next to the carcass (as the deer's graze), not for standing there in Feed mode; the rest unchanged.

terms.name: gnaw
terms.expr: 0.15 * step(0.95 - energy) * mode_feed * step(2.5 - carcass_distance) * max(0, 1 - muzzle_height)

terms.name: pair
terms.expr: 0.05 * adult * (1 - pregnant) * step(energy - 0.6) * mode_mate * step(3 - mate_distance)
